note: Adjudicated accidental and house-orthography variants. The witnesses agree on the substantive text.

adjudicated.ruling: The typical edition's spelling is retained under the house orthography. The witness reading is the same word in another editorial spelling.
The typical edition prints appetámus (p. 417), the subjunctive the clause with ut requires. The digital source prints the indicative appétimus.
The typical edition's punctuation is retained. The difference marks phrasing and does not change the words.
